mimo.notes: logit_bias accepted but silently ignored; top_logprobs always empty. Chosen-token logprob is graded on uncertain prompts (P=0.65 on 'pick A or B at random', 0.49 on 'is a hot dog a sandwich', 0.95 on coin flip), so P(A) or 1-P(B) is usable. HF repo for tokenizer is MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL; A=32, B=33.
